abstract: BACKGROUND: A 9-year-old boy was admitted to Jikei University Hospital complaining of gradual enlarging of the left scrotal contents. METHODS/RESULTS: Physical examination was significant for bilateral descended testicles. No abnormalities were detected in the testicles or along the spermatic cords. Scrotal ultrasound showed that hyperechoic shadows were recognized in the central area of the left testicle. Subsequent testicular biopsy and histopathological examination showed intratubular malignant germ cells in the testicular tubules. One week later, left orchiectomy was performed. CONCLUSIONS: Histopathological evaluation revealed gonadoblastoma. Gonadoblastoma, a rare gonadal neoplasm, is composed of germ cells and sex cord derivatives and usually occurs in phenotypically female patients with gonadal dysgenesis. To date, only three cases of gonadoblastoma have been reported in anatomically normal male patients with scrotal testicles. We report on a case of gonadoblastoma unaccompanied by a germ cell tumor in a physically normal male.
abstract_ja: 9歳男児が左陰嚢内容の増大を主訴に当院を受診した。両側の精巣は下降しており、身体所見に異常を認めなかった。精巣および精索に異常はなかった。陰嚢超音波検査で、左精巣の中心部に高エコー像を認めた。精巣生検と病理組織学的検査で、精細管内に悪性胚細胞を認めた。1週間後に左精精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的検査で性腺芽細胞腫と診断された。性腺芽細胞腫は、胚細胞と性索由来の成分から構成される稀な性腺腫瘍で、通常は性腺異形成を伴う表現型女性に生じる。陰嚢内精巣を有する解剖学的に正常な男性での報告は、これまでに3例しかない。本報告は、胚細胞腫瘍を伴わない身体的に正常な男性の性腺芽細胞腫の1例である。
